🎓 Professional CBC Curriculum Engine

SSEDU v21 uses an automatic syllabus-driven curriculum engine. It does not present generic framework text as syllabus content. Each installed record carries a source/status and is used automatically by Lesson Plans, Schemes, Records of Work and Assessments.

Verified in this build: Form 1 Term 1 Mathematics I and Mathematics II curriculum records, including specific competences, general competences, expected standards, teaching content, activities and worked mathematical examples.

🗂️ Zambia CBC Syllabus Content Library — FULL v23

Comprehensive content installed: ECE, Grades 1–6 and Forms 1–6, with topics, sub-topics, specific competences, expected standards, syllabus content, suggested activities and assessment guidance. Official Ministry/CDC syllabus documents remain the authority and are linked below.

Syllabus-first CBC mode: Lesson Plans, Schemes, Records, Exercises and Assessment use installed syllabus records; generated teaching notes are clearly separated from official syllabus content. The system no longer invents “concepts and terminology / guided practice” as if they were official syllabus content.

CBC structure used by SSEDU: General Competence(s) → Topic/Sub-topic → Specific Competence(s) → Expected Standard → Syllabus Content → Suggested Learning Activities → Assessment. The system does not rename a specific competence as a generic learning outcome.

Official curriculum authority: Ministry of Education / Curriculum Development Centre. The 2023 Zambia Education Curriculum Framework provides the national structure; detailed subject content belongs to the approved syllabi.

🧒 Primary School Management Centre

Primary-focused tools for weekly planning, learner monitoring, classroom records and continuous assessment.

SSEDU v21 • Official-content-first Primary + Secondary Portals
SSEDU visual environment uses real school photographs from Zambia and educational projects; images are used under their stated licences.
